name: Composed editing examples
desc: Complete edits that combine captured ranges, localized evaluation, macro calls and formatted text reconstruction.

tests.name: Match a change before applying it
tests.desc: Captures supply both edit coordinates and a snapshot of the original data.

tests.name: Replace steps inside named markers
tests.desc: The capture path reaches into the object for both the snapshot and the splice.

tests.name: Reject reversed steps
tests.desc: The same edit requires the complete ordered context before it can replace the captured span.

tests.name: Find the remaining occurrence after an array grows
tests.desc: The second invocation prepares a fresh match after the first splice changes both values and offsets. A START anchor and a short prefix select the first occurrence.

tests.name: Evaluate in the scope of each edit
tests.desc: Localized accumulators, call arguments and current nodes change between invocations.

tests.name: Invoice subtotal and original fee
tests.desc: REDUCE starts at the localized fee and shadows it with each subtotal. Its sibling reads the original fee.

tests.name: Label two records under nested calls
tests.desc: The inner override applies to the first record. The second uses its caller’s prefix, and the final read observes the original stash.

tests.name: Refresh a selection after binding and data edits
tests.desc: The same value macro sees two thresholds and a later source append. Each saved selection is independent.

tests.name: Edit formatted text
tests.desc: Actions transform visible field values while preserving the separators and trimmings required for reconstruction.

tests.name: Update a line while preserving indentation and line endings
tests.desc: The capture supplies the field index for an overwrite. The following action reads the reassembled string at the outer node.

tests.name: Guard the text edit when its target line is absent
tests.desc: Failure propagates out of the nested MATCH and ATSPLIT.

tests.name: Filter then transform a delimited record
tests.desc: Filtering keeps the separators of surviving fields and mapping overwrites the surviving values.
